variants.headline: Strike collapses
variants.body: A strike has collapsed in {colony}. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.

variants.headline: Labour action loses its course
variants.body: The colony has seen a strike collapse. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.

variants.headline: A strike ends in collapse
variants.body: A strike in the colony has ended in collapse. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.
